authority: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames

quirks.summary: Planning committee reports, late material and minutes are not on the Idox documents tab; they are published on the council's Modern.gov committee system.
quirks.detail: For a committee-determined major application the Idox documents tab carries the decision notice, s106 and application documents but no committee report, so a retrieval that stops at Idox reports 'no officer report' when one exists. Delegated reports and non-material amendment reasoning are generally not published on either system. The Planning Committee is CId=138 on https://moderngov.kingston.gov.uk/. Meetings for a year are listed at ieListMeetings.aspx?CId=138&Year=YYYY; each meeting links to ieListDocuments.aspx?CId=138&MId=<meeting id>, whose agenda links the report and late material as documents/s<NNNNN>/<name>.pdf. The committee system served paced requests with a browser User-Agent without a challenge.
quirks.workaround: For a committee decision, find the meeting from the decision date (or a few months before it), open the Planning Committee meeting list for that year, and fetch the report and late material from the agenda page. Record the report as not published only after checking both systems.

quirks.summary: Consecutive application-detail requests at 3 s spacing drew repeated HTTP 429s; 5 s spacing was stable.
quirks.detail: A site-history run resolving linked applications one after another at 3 s spacing was answered with 429 on nearly every request once the limit tripped. At 5 s spacing, documents-tab reads and file downloads for some 40 applications completed without a 429. The WAF signals below are the likely source.
quirks.workaround: Pace at 5 s or slower, stop on the first run of 429s rather than retrying, and prefer search-result metadata over per-application detail requests where it carries what is needed.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

pacing.note: 429s at 3 s spacing on consecutive application-detail requests; 5 s was stable.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (idox-public-access); WAF signals: cloudflare

Documents tabs and file downloads for about 40 applications on one site at 5 s spacing, magic bytes checked, no 429. Earlier the same day, detail-page requests at 3 s spacing drew repeated 429s.
